name: rusty-bacnet
description: Discover and read BACnet building automation devices through a profile you authorized; read-only unless the profile allows writes.
long_description:
Runs `bacnet mcp serve --stdio` from the rusty-bacnet CLI. The server connects through a `bacnet tui` profile, whose `[mcp]` table limits the networks, devices and rates an agent may use.

**Before installing**, authorize the profile in a terminal: `bacnet mcp authorize --profile NAME`. A profile that isn't authorized stops the server at start with a message that names this command.

The server is read-only by default: write tools appear only when the profile's `[mcp]` table offers them. A write then needs a person's approval, given for that write in the host or ahead of time by a plan grant authorized with the profile.

tools.name: bacnet_discover
tools.description: Send a Who-Is and list the devices that answer

tools.name: bacnet_find_object
tools.description: Find objects across discovered devices by name, description or type

tools.name: bacnet_network_map
tools.description: Show the reachable networks, their routers and devices

tools.name: bacnet_describe_device
tools.description: Summarise a device: vendor, model, firmware, services and objects

tools.name: bacnet_read_trend
tools.description: Read and summarise a trend log's records

tools.name: bacnet_read_log_records
tools.description: Read and summarise an Event Log's or Audit Log's records

tools.name: bacnet_alarms
tools.description: List a device's objects in alarm or fault

tools.name: bacnet_decode
tools.description: Decode a BACnet frame given as hex, sending nothing

tools.name: bacnet_watch
tools.description: Follow points and report which changed since the last call

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: The name of a bacnet TUI profile that `bacnet mcp authorize --profile NAME` authorized in a terminal.
